import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a countplot of the top 10 most common dog breeds
top_10_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x=top_10_breeds.index, data=top_10_breeds, order=top_10_breeds.index)
plt.title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Dog Breed')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
